findings.evidence: `rg -n '\bchange\b'` reports line 56, immediately followed by `MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply`; unlike the justified uses at lines 147 and 152, it has no explanatory comment.
findings.fix: Expose this application through an explicit lemma or prove the equality by unfolding/rewrite lemmas without `change`; otherwise document why no API rewrite can reach the goal.
findings.issue: `orthogonalGroupToGL_coe` uses an undocumented `change` across the `toLin` equivalence and coercions.

findings.evidence: Lines 96–97 define `hstar : star g = gᵀ := rfl`; Mathlib exposes `Matrix.star_apply` in `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/ConjTranspose.lean:417`.
findings.fix: Prove the equality extensionally using `Matrix.star_apply` and coefficient-level trivial-star simplification, or add/reuse an explicit lemma for matrices over `starRingOfComm`.

summary: Two proofs still depend on fragile definitional equality instead of explicit API lemmas.
